clue.text: Vegetarian food in flower, obsolete

indicators.note: in tells us the vegetarian food sits within the flower

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, here the River Ouse
tofu is a bean curd eaten by vegetarians

explanation.surface: A vegetarian dish served inside a blossom has gone out of fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is a crossword trick: read it as flow-er, a river. The Ouse is an English river.
explanation.definitionFit: Something no longer employed is obsolete; the phrase is an idiom for disused.

clue.text: High time for a palindrome?

indicators.note: the clue asks for a word that reads the same either way, which is the extra wordplay here

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A whimsical question asking whether a palindrome is long overdue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High time' suggests 'about time', but it means the hour when the sun is highest; the answer also reads the same backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve o'clock midday is when the sun stands highest, as in the film title High Noon.

clue.text: Most senior school destroyed, though not all of it

indicators.note: only part of the words school destroyed is used, so the answer lies hidden within them

explanation.surface: The most senior school has been partly demolished.
explanation.definitionFit: The most senior person is the one with the greatest age, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Requiring a kind of light and energy, it is an eye problem

parts.note: UV is short for ultraviolet light
E is the physics symbol for energy
taken as written

explanation.surface: An eye condition that apparently needs light and energy to develop.
explanation.definitionFit: Uveitis is inflammation of the uvea, the middle layer of the eyeball, a medical eye condition.

clue.text: Spinner's game allowed to get in the way

indicators.note: to get in places the permitted word inside the way

parts.note: a route is a way to go
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A gamer is permitted to obstruct things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spinner's game' is the casino wheel game where a spinning wheel and ball decide the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is played by spinning a wheel, so it is the game of the spinner.

clue.text: After disco dancing, made 2 and 3 from 6, perhaps?

indicators.note: dancing suggests the letters of after and disco jigging into a new order

explanation.surface: After an evening at the disco, someone did some arithmetic with small numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is an example: splitting 6 into its prime parts 2 and 3; 'perhaps' flags the example.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking a number into numbers that multiply to give it is what the mathematical verb describes.

clue.text: Gourmet's comment about oxygen, as element

indicators.note: about means the comment goes around the oxygen symbol

parts.note: a gourmet might say 'I dine'
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A food lover remarks about oxygen as a chemical element.
explanation.definitionFit: Iodine is a chemical element, number 53, a halogen.

clue.text: Man returning with endless capital, a very old European

indicators.note: returning means the word for man is read backwards

parts.note: a guy is a man

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the capital is cut off

parts.note: Oslo is the capital of Norway

explanation.surface: A man comes back with a capital, plus an ancient European.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of the former Yugoslavia is a European of a state that no longer exists.

clue.text: Speaker switching one and a half schedules

indicators.note: switching means the string of letters is turned round

parts.note: a schedule is a rota; one and a half of them is a full rota then half of a rota, RO

explanation.surface: A speaker juggling a timetable and a bit.
explanation.walkthrough: ROTA plus half of ROTA gives ROTARO, which 'switching' turns end to end.
explanation.definitionFit: An orator is a public speaker, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Losing lead, cry for horse

indicators.note: losing lead means the first letter of the word for cry is dropped

parts.note: a groan is a cry of pain

explanation.surface: A horse that is losing a race begins to moan.
explanation.definitionFit: A roan is a horse whose coat has white hairs mixed in.

clue.text: Flap by which sleazebag accesses toilets, dubiously

indicators.note: accesses means the sleazebag gets inside the rearranged toilets
dubiously suggests the letters of toilets are dodgily rearranged

parts.note: a pig is a contemptible, sleazy person

explanation.surface: A creep sneaks into the lavatories through some kind of flap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dubiously' makes ELOTTIS from toilets, and 'accesses' puts PIG inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The epiglottis is the flap of cartilage that covers the windpipe when swallowing.

clue.text: Expert just cut into car, bumper dropping off

indicators.note: into places the cut word for just inside the car
the bumper is the end of the car, so its last letter goes

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car

indicators.note: cut means the last letter is trimmed

parts.note: fair means just

explanation.surface: An expert cuts in on a car and loses the bumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bumper' is the car's rear end; 'cut' and 'bumper dropping off' each trim a last letter, and 'into' sets one shortened word inside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means well informed or conversant with, so an expert is fully acquainted.

clue.text: Splattered on my coat is a muscle protein

indicators.note: splattered suggests the letters on my coat is spread around anew

explanation.surface: A muscle protein has been splashed across my jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: Actomyosin is the complex of actin and myosin proteins that makes muscle contract.

clue.text: Source of facts or otherwise in flier, text missing odd parts

parts.note: a tern is a seabird, a flier

indicators.note: missing odd parts means only the even letters of text remain

explanation.surface: Information is printed on a leaflet, but bits of the text are gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flier' looks like a leaflet but is a bird; 'or otherwise' wittily allows that online facts may be false.
explanation.definitionFit: The web is a source of information, true or not, as the setter wryly suggests.

clue.text: Writing crosswords is getting hard

definitions.meaning: compiling a puzzle is the setter's work, called by that word
concrete or jelly firming up is said to be doing this

explanation.definitionFit: Compiling puzzles is called this, and the same word means becoming firm as glue does.

clue.text: Explosion of neon right after leakage of hydrogen gas

indicators.note: explosion of means the letters are blown apart and reassembled
leakage of means the hydrogen letter escapes from right

parts.note: H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: Neon explodes just after a hydrogen leak, a gas incident.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing H from right leaves RIGT; with NEON that is shuffled into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitrogen is the gas forming most of the air we breathe.

clue.text: Entertainment with plenty of kicks, say, mum going in deep

indicators.note: going in places the pieces inside the word for deep

parts.note: a low voice is a deep one
eg (for example) means say
sh, as in keep mum, means be quiet

explanation.surface: A show full of thrills, with a mother going into deep waters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' is not a mother but the call for silence.
explanation.definitionFit: A revue of dancers kicking their legs is a variety entertainment, here wittily described.

clue.text: Actress Dawn, one under actor Laurence

indicators.note: under places the one below the actor in this down clue

parts.note: Laurence Olivier was the great English actor
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An actress playing a supporting role beneath a famous actor.
explanation.walkthrough: Dawn Olivieri is an American television actress; 'under' works because this is a down clue, so the I sits below the actor's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Dawn Olivieri is an American television actress, so the surname completes her name.

clue.text: Chef regularly cut herb with a French mark

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of chef
cut means the herb loses its last letter

parts.note: dill is a herb
la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A cook chops herbs, with a French accent mark.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly LA is French for 'the', but setters accept 'a French' for a French article.
explanation.definitionFit: A cedilla is a diacritic mark placed beneath a c, as in français.

clue.text: Small compartment in 'ouse with tight walls — something fishy about it?

indicators.note: about means the fishy word goes round the other letters

parts.note: roe is fish eggs
a dropped-h house is a Cockney 'ome

indicators.note: the walls of tight are its outer letters

explanation.surface: A tiny room in a cramped house that smells of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'ouse signals a dropped H, so the synonym loses it too: 'ome.
explanation.definitionFit: A roomette is a small private sleeping compartment on a train.

clue.text: Former tax on certain things requiring one's inspection for starters

indicators.note: for starters means take the first letter of each of these words

explanation.surface: A historic levy on goods that had to be inspected.
explanation.definitionFit: An octroi was a local duty on goods entering a town, a now-defunct levy.

clue.text: Shift dressing single bird

indicators.note: dressing means the word for shift goes around like clothing

parts.note: budge means shift or move
I is one, single

explanation.surface: Move clothes on one bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A budgerigar is a small parrot, a common caged bird.

clue.text: Keen to see monster swallowing vessel

indicators.note: swallowing means the monster takes the vessel inside

parts.note: monster means huge, big
a tin is a container

explanation.surface: Eager to see a beast gulp down a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'monster' is an adjective here, as in a monster portion.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen wind is a sharp, cutting one, a biting wind.

clue.text: One studying animal behaviour got hostile, wild

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of got hostile running loose

explanation.surface: A researcher of animal habits turned aggressive and wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethology is the science of animal behaviour, so its practitioner fits.

clue.text: Network free after midnight

indicators.note: after puts the word for free behind the midnight letter

parts.note: the middle of night is the letter G
to rid is to free

explanation.surface: A network becomes free after midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: A grid is a network of lines, as in the electricity grid.

clue.text: Travel one way, then another, as a habit

parts.note: go means travel
W is west, a compass direction
N is north, another direction

explanation.surface: Travelling first one way and then another becomes a habit.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a monk's or nun's robe, a kind of long garment.

clue.text: Volume Four behind books ending in marriage, in fulfilment of vows

indicators.note: behind puts four after the books

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books
IV is the Roman numeral four

indicators.note: ending in means take the last letter of marriage

explanation.surface: The fourth volume of a series ends in a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A votive offering is given to fulfil a vow, so the adjective fits exactly.

clue.text: From the water and wine, only beginning to get through fat

indicators.note: to get through means passing inside the word for fat

parts.note: lard is pig fat
taken as written

indicators.note: only beginning means only the first letter of wine

explanation.surface: Wine sipped through a fatty meal, from the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'only beginning' leaves just W of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving towards the shore from the sea is moving in the direction of land.
